newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: S.Lanka plans new laws to ease traffic congestion.
newsitem.headline: S.Lanka plans new laws to ease traffic congestion.

text.p: Sri Lanka plans to introduce legislation to make it mandatory for private vehicles entering the capital Colombo to carry at least five passengers in a bid to ease traffic congestion, the independent Island said Tuesday.

The newspaper quoted Highways and Transport Minister Mohammed Fowzie as saying that the legislation will be introduced if a luxury bus service proposed for middle class office workers did not reduce the 25,000 private vehicles that enter the city daily.
The minister said more than 2,000 vehicles that entered the city limits carried only a single passenger.
Initially ten new luxury buses will ply the city roads from September 1, and the fleet will subsequently be increased to 200 to provide public transport for office workers.
But if the response to the new bus service is poor, new laws will have to be introduced to ease the traffic congestion in the city, the minister said.
He did not give further details of the proposal.
